title: Postgres Connection-Pooling Plan
description: A structured plan for a Postgres pooling setup so scripts/postgres_connection_pooling_audit.mjs can check it deterministically against this skill's feature matrix and Quality Gates.

poolMode.description: The pool mode the plan intends to run.

pooler.description: The pooling layer in front of Postgres.

usesListen.description: True if the app uses LISTEN (session-only in transaction mode).

usesSessionAdvisoryLocks.description: True if the app takes session-level advisory locks (pg_advisory_lock).

usesWithHoldCursors.description: True if the app uses WITH HOLD cursors.

usesSessionSet.description: True if the app or ORM emits session-scoped SET/RESET (e.g. SET search_path per session).

usesSqlPrepare.description: True if the app uses SQL-level PREPARE/EXECUTE/DEALLOCATE (never tracked by poolers).

usesTempTables.description: True if the app creates temporary tables/sequences/views (pins RDS Proxy sessions).

usesMultiStatementTransactions.description: True if the app runs multi-statement transactions (disallowed in statement mode).

usesProtocolPreparedStatements.description: True if the client library uses protocol-level named prepared statements (Prisma, postgres-js, asyncpg defaults).

poolerTracksPreparedStatements.description: True if the pooler can track protocol-level prepared statements (pgBouncer >= 1.21 / Supavisor with PS support).

maxPreparedStatements.description: The pgBouncer max_prepared_statements value; must be non-zero to enable tracking (200 is the 1.22+ default).

idleInTransactionTimeoutSeconds.description: idle_in_transaction_session_timeout in seconds; 0 (the Postgres default) disables it and fails the audit.

idleSessionTimeoutEnabled.description: True if idle_session_timeout is enabled (a hazard behind a pooler).

initQueryForSessionState.description: True if identical per-connection SET statements are moved into the RDS Proxy InitQuery.

pinnedSessionAlarm.description: True if a CloudWatch alarm watches DatabaseConnectionsCurrentlySessionPinned.

migrationPlanFlush.description: How cached plans are flushed after column-altering migrations.

supabaseWorkload.description: The workload class, for Supabase deployments.

supabasePort.description: The Supabase port in use: 5432 (direct/Supavisor session) or 6543 (Supavisor transaction).

expectedConcurrentClients.description: Expected concurrent client connections; > 100 with no pooler fails.
